continuation_context.key_insight: The depth-1 gap is bridgeable via EF-game-style duplicator strategy: at each round, find witness with one-lower-depth agreement. After K+1 rounds, depth 0 (purely atomic). The proof chain: depth-K 3-var -> depth-(K-1) 4-var -> ... -> depth-0 (K+3)-var. At depth 0: atoms only, no quantifier conditions. The formalization challenge is the simultaneously increasing arity and decreasing depth in the Nat.rec.
